task: Fix EPMCDME-17316: project.created activity event for a mixed-case-email user's personal project is not found by entity_id.

key_reasoning.reason: Root cause is not established. The emitter in personal_project_service.py already writes the canonical stored name (EPMCDME-16566 is in this tree). The strongest lead is that EmailStr lowercases the email domain for admin-created and registered users, while ActivityEventRepository.find_all matches entity_id exactly and case-sensitively. The fix has several valid designs: change DTO email normalization, change event matching, or change the harness query. A stand-build difference or a swallowed insert failure is also still possible. Acceptance criterion 4 lives in another repo and cannot be run here. These open design decisions are the main rework risk.

red_flags_applied: Clarity red flag: the task's premise (project stored under the typed mixed-case name) is contradicted by code findings, so Requirements Clarity was set to L.
